limitations: Twenty exposed unique sources, 24 frozen synthetic constructions and four repeats. Labels and descriptions are audit-only, not representative external SAT evidence. The wide-failure motifs contain complementary clauses and can fold into binary constraints; retain this limitation instead of treating every constructed wide case as novel probe coverage.

Binary wraps preceding repeated binary forcing. Scan then performs repeated full-CNF failed-assumption scans. Indexed uses one immutable literal-occurrence index per probe round, shared by all its probes; per-probe assignments, pending counts, satisfied clauses and queues are private. Propagation trace order can differ; completed failed-assumption sets and resulting residual graphs must agree.

At most 128 attempted probes cumulatively per incoming cofactor and eight probe rounds, in addition to the preceding binary-closure quotas. A successor requires strict active-variable decrease. Every unit call separately has 512 steps and 262144 reserved index-work units; buckets retain depth two, width eight and 262144 probes. Probe setup, repeated scans, reason searches, checking, persistence, time and RAM are additional. There is no per-probe wall-time cap.

Each failed-assumption certificate is checked from the exact source with its assumption fixed, then reason clauses and final conflict. Nonfailed probes do not certify SAT. The opposite literal is entailed and is added as a unit with source-bound round transport. The checker caps stored failures, not the unrecorded unsuccessful discovery attempts.

Indexes are scoped to one unchanged CNF in one discovery round. Source edits, unit restrictions and renaming invalidate the index. Complete residual/depth nodes and exact whole-root programs retain their checked reuse rules. Every incoming history is separately checked; unknown is not UNSAT and split refutation needs both children.

Four cyclic process orders start empty with one common fallback. Complete time charges preparation, discovery, checking, writes, warm/cold replay and compression. Startup, metadata, generation, historical acquisition, diagnostics and final lineage audit are additional.

Both native cold readers check fallback archives; extra JSON passes share one checker. All prior scientific files, native/equivalence/affine/Lean formats and production defaults remain unchanged. No efficient unrestricted SAT or general compact-closure guarantee follows.
